title: CascadeScope: single-patient Immune Cascade Index (ICI) scoring
description: CascadeScope is a self-contained R/Shiny application that computes and visualizes the Immune Cascade Index (ICI), a 98-gene, three-layer (Sensory, Integration, Execution) transcriptomic read-out of the anti-tumor immune response to immune-checkpoint blockade. Each tumor RNA-seq sample is self-normalized and scored against a frozen, locked per-gene reference, so the score is deterministic and cohort-independent for a single patient. Outputs include a per-patient report (archetype call, standardized-score gauge, cascade drill-down, 98-gene cascade tree), a cohort explorer, and version-stamped exports. Research use only: investigational, not a validated clinical test.
